  context={"endpoint"}

Adds a widget for an object to the space sidebar (scope space, owner and admins) or to this account's own (scope personal, any member who can write). One widget per target per scope. The layout and limit follow the app's own rules: a layout the target cannot render, or a limit off the app's list, is replaced with the app's fallback and reported in warnings.
